newsitem.title: CHINA: Israel's UDI to set up Shanghai diamond exchange.
newsitem.headline: Israel's UDI to set up Shanghai diamond exchange.

text.p: Israel's United Development Inc (UDI) has signed an agreement with Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development to invest $60 million in setting up a diamond exchange, a company said on Tuesday.
The Shanghai Lujiazui official told Reuters the agreement had not yet been finalised, and declined to give further details of the terms.
UDI is already involved in about 30 joint ventures in China in a variety of sectors, including petrochemicals, and reportedly has good contacts with senior Chinese government officials.
Shanghia's Xinmin Evening News said the exchange would be the world's 24th diamond exchange.

Covering 35,000 square metres (377,000 sq ft), the diamond exchange would be located in the Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone in Pudong, Shanghai's premier economic development area, it said without giving further detail.
